summary.result: The results show that the identified functional regions are wider than those identified in previous studies, effectively addressing the influence of central city and thoroughly incorporating sprawled regions.
summary.background: The purposes of this study are to delineate functional regions with mathematical methods, specifically Markov-chain model and cluster analysis, and analyze the regions in terms of changes of boundaries.
summary.method: Although there have been existing studies that delineated city-regions using commuting data and other variables, most authors used a cut-off method that is somewhat arbitrary and requires local knowledge by authors.
